findings.text: They had had him in the loft, frozen to the waist with an arrow through his sleeve, and nobody had told him what to say. Somebody had, months ago, with a needle and thread.
findings.deletionTest: They had had him in the loft, frozen to the waist with an arrow through his sleeve. Somebody had told him what to say months ago, with a needle and thread.
findings.reason: This is a 'nobody had X. Somebody had.' reversal, the same move as 'It should not have helped. It did.' The negative clause sets up the reveal and adds no fact, because 'And he hadn't' in the sentence before already says Tam kept his line. With the negative cut, the sentence states the real fact directly.
findings.suggestedFix: They had had him in the loft, frozen to the waist with an arrow through his sleeve. Somebody had told him what to say months ago, with a needle and thread.
